title: Partially check #4603's query-shear floor: exact Laurent identity, 15 disjoint ADD/IDLE windows in the pinned controller, merge saving 0.70 < 1 (no new κ)
body:
Partial independent check of Matarener's #4603 (head `caab2b42`), the p16 query-shear floor. **The three checked statements hold.** No new κ.

`research/pr4603-shear-floor-check/verify.py` uses the standard library only and takes about 1 s. Nothing is imported from #4603.

## Results

1. **Exact identity.** S_x(−Q)·S_y(Q⁻¹) = signed_swap·diag(Q⁻¹,Q)·S_x(Q) holds, checked with exact Laurent-polynomial arithmetic. The product is [[0,−Q],[Q⁻¹,1]], and a wrong-sign control is rejected.
2. **Window premise,** on main's pinned complex controller:
   - between each of the 15 shears and the last full call on its own pair there are **only ADD and IDLE** events;
   - the 15 windows are pairwise disjoint.

   So any scheme paying at least 1 per window pays at least 15, which the controller attains. An inserted SIGNED_SWAP is detected.
3. **Merge bound.** Merging 112 rank-one jobs into 14 rank-eight jobs saves **0.701 < 1** unit of moment at the current root.

## Not covered

- the fusion Q-coefficient ranks;
- the distinct-line census;
- the BIT controller's windows;
- the parity model's rules.

Credit: Matarener (Mark) for #4603; 1337isnot1337 / Cinna Davis and zxv for the controllers. Ryanson Jonathan, with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance.
